mapper.select: select sp.*,ss.step_order from simulation_progress sp LEFT JOIN scenario_step ss ON sp.step_id = ss.step_id where member_id = #{memberId} and sp.progress_status != 'DELETED' and sp.progress_id = ( select sp2.progress_id from simulation_progress sp2 where sp2.member_id = sp.member_id and sp2.scenario_id = sp.scenario_id order by sp2.started_at DESC, sp2.progress_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.insert: insert into simulation_progress(member_id, scenario_id, step_id) values( #{memberId}, #{scenarioId}, #{stepId} )
mapper.select: select progress_id from simulation_progress where member_id = #{memberId} and scenario_id = #{scenarioId} order by started_at DESC, progress_id DESC limit 1
mapper.update: UPDATE simulation_progress p SET p.step_id = NULL, p.progress_status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE p.progress_id = #{progressId} AND p.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.step_id = #{currentStepId} AND p.progress_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND p.step_id = ( SELECT s.step_id FROM scenario_step s WHERE s.scenario_id = p.scenario_id AND s.step_order > 0 ORDER BY s.step_order DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scenario_step current_step JOIN scenario_step target_step ON current_step.scenario_id = target_step.scenario_id WHERE current_step.step_id = #{currentStepId} AND target_step.step_id = #{targetStepId} AND current_step.scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND current_step.step_order > 0 AND target_step.step_order > 0 AND target_step.step_order = current_step.step_order - 1 )
